SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT

This Software Development Agreement is between Pallas Systems LLC ("Developer") and Greywater Outfitters, Inc. ("Client").

1. Services. Developer will design and build the mobile ordering application described in the Statement of Work.

2. Fees. Client will pay Developer $180,000 in three milestone payments.

3. Ownership. The software is a work made for hire and belongs to Client.

4. Warranty. Developer warrants that the software will conform to the Statement of Work for 90 days after delivery.
